🎨 Key Takeaways from Codédex.io for Your Design

Font & Typography

Codédex uses pixel / retro-style bold fonts for headings.

Body text is simple sans-serif, clean and readable.

For your Figma:

Headings: Press Start 2P or VT323 (retro pixel vibe)

Body text: Inter or Poppins for readability

Background & Visual Depth

Multi-layered background with mountains, trees, grass → gives depth and immersion.

Subtle parallax animation when scrolling → adds movement without distraction.

Pixel art flowers, clouds, or stars → playful touch.

Color Palette

Soft greens, blues, purples for natural but eye-catching look.

Contrast: Yellow / neon for CTA buttons.

Soft shadows and highlights for cards / elements.

Gamified Elements

XP / reward characters → like your computer mascot in Codédex.

Floating stars, coins, confetti → micro-rewards to hook daily login.

Progress indicators → streaks, points, badges.

UI Style

Rounded buttons with subtle shadows / glow.

Cards slightly raised with soft hover effect.

Minimal clutter → focus on playful illustration + CTA.

🖥️ Figma Implementation for Your Onboarding Page

Frame: Desktop 1440×1024

1️⃣ Background Layers:

Layer 1: Distant mountains with muted blues/greens

Layer 2: Trees in midground (slightly darker)

Layer 3: Foreground grass, flowers → add slight parallax movement

Layer 4: Floating XP/coins/stars (soft animation loop)

2️⃣ Hero Section:

Left: Headline (Press Start 2P) → “🎯 Level Up Your CUET Prep!”

Subtext: “Practice, earn XP, unlock badges, track your streaks daily.” (Inter / Poppins)

CTA Button: Rounded, yellow gradient, glow on hover → “Start Your Quest →”

Right: Mascot illustration → e.g., computer with smiley / CUET avatar, floating hearts or XP bubbles

3️⃣ Gamified Preview Section:

Horizontal carousel: Question cards with XP reward, mini streaks

Cards lift + soft shadow + subtle bounce on hover

4️⃣ Progress & Reward Section:

Circular XP progress charts, streak bars 🔥, small badge pop-ins

Soft pastel confetti animation when reaching milestones

5️⃣ Final CTA Section:

Headline: “🚀 Begin Your CUET Adventure”

CTA: “Claim Your First Quest →” (button glows softly, small floating stars around)

💡 Extra Tips

Parallax: Move background layers at slightly different speeds on scroll → adds immersion.

Consistency: Use the same pixel/retro font for all gamified headings to tie it together.

Animation: Keep subtle — smooth loops for stars, XP, coins. Avoid rapid flashy animations.

Color: Yellow CTA buttons on green/blue background pop naturally and feel playful.
